show.title: CyberEyeQ Weekly Podcast
show.subtitle: 10-minute weekly briefings on the regulatory stories that actually matter
show.description: Two hosts break down enforcement actions, compliance deadlines, and policy developments across AI governance, privacy, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare, and child safety regulation. Produced from CyberEyeQ's daily regulation tracking pipeline.
show.author: CyberEyeQ

episodes.title: Episode 17: COPPA Deadline in 4 Days + China AI Companion Law
episodes.summary: FTC's amended COPPA Rule takes effect April 22 (4 days). China's AI Companion Law passes second NPCSC reading. Plus updates on EU AI Act GPAI compliance and 3 enforcement actions worth tracking.

episodes.title: Episode 18: EU AI Act Countdown + Iranian OT Attacks on US Infrastructure
episodes.summary: EU AI Act Omnibus trilogue targets April 28 for a deal that would push high-risk compliance to December 2027 — but August 2 remains operative until enacted. Plus: Iranian APTs actively attacking US critical infrastructure PLCs, COPPA 2025 now in force, China supply chain data conflicts, and FDA-CMS RAPID device coverage pathway.

episodes.title: Episode 19: EU Digital Omnibus Lands + $1.165M HIPAA Ransomware Bundle
episodes.summary: EU AI Act Digital Omnibus hits political agreement at the April 28 trilogue with a three-track new timeline (Annex III Dec 2 2027, Annex I Aug 2 2028, watermarking Nov 2 2026). Plus: OCR's $1.165M four-settlement HIPAA ransomware bundle, today's Ofcom OSA platform deadline, China's eight-agency crypto-marketing ban, and the EDPB's 25-DPA transparency sweep.

episodes.title: Episode 20: EU AI Three-Track Timeline + EUDAMED Deadline + China Crypto Marketing Ban
episodes.summary: Three-week look at the regtech week-of-April-30: EU Digital Omnibus on AI emerges as a three-track program (watermarking Nov 2 2026, Annex III Dec 2 2027, Annex I Aug 2 2028), HHS OCR's $1.165M four-settlement HIPAA ransomware bundle, today's Ofcom OSA platform deadline, China's eight-agency online crypto-marketing ban, and the EDPB's 25-DPA Article 12-14 transparency sweep. EUDAMED four-module mandatory use lands May 28.

episodes.title: Episode 21: EU AI Three-Track Locks In + Record $12.75M CCPA Fine + China AI Agents
episodes.summary: EU AI Act Digital Omnibus reaches political agreement May 7 (Annex III to Dec 2 2027, GPAI still Aug 2 2026). California AG hits GM/OnStar with a record $12.75M CCPA penalty for selling driver telemetry. Plus: Connecticut SB 5 / SB 4 and Colorado SB 26-189 advance, China issues the first horizontal AI-agent regime, CMS freezes new hospice/HHA Medicare enrollments for six months, Luxembourg NIS2 goes live, and FedRAMP CR26 hits public preview.

episodes.title: Episode 22: CIRCIA Still Missing + EU AI Transparency August 2 + CT Neural Data
episodes.summary: CIRCIA's final rule is still unpublished past its May 2026 target, leaving 300,000 critical infrastructure entities in limbo with $500K/day penalties ahead. Plus: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations still land August 2, Connecticut pioneers neural data protections, and two sector deadlines hit this week — NERC CIP-003-11 on May 26 and EUDAMED on May 28.

episodes.title: Episode 23: EU AI Act Omnibus Rewrites Deadlines; EUDAMED Live Today; CMMC at 1%
episodes.summary: The EU AI Act Omnibus splits compliance deadlines — high-risk AI gets more time, but GPAI and Article 50 obligations stay fixed at August 2. EUDAMED mandatory as of today. CMMC Phase 2 has 166 days and 99% of contractors uncertified.

episodes.title: Episode 24: EUDAMED Live; NIS2 Audit in 33 Days; CMMC at 1% Ready
episodes.summary: EUDAMED is now mandatory in the EU — plus the NIS2 first audit deadline closes June 30, CMMC Phase 2 has just 1% of contractors certified with 166 days to go, and the EU AI Act Omnibus reshuffles high-risk deadlines while leaving August 2 transparency obligations intact.

episodes.title: Episode 25: Canada's under-16 social ban; CISA's 72-hour patch clock
episodes.summary: Canada tables Bill C-34 with a 16-year social media minimum age, CISA's BOD 26-04 starts a three-day patch clock for federal agencies, and Brussels publishes the AI-labelling Code of Practice. Plus the five-week deadline corridor: a dozen compliance dates between June 13 and July 18.

episodes.title: Episode 26: EU delays AI Act; July deadline wall builds
episodes.summary: The EU Parliament voted to delay the AI Act's high-risk rules to 2027-2028, but the August 2 transparency duties still stand. Plus a dense corridor of July 1 deadlines: MiCA's crypto hard stop, EU ESG ratings, US state AI and age laws, and two new China PIPL standards.

episodes.title: Episode 27: EU AI Act signoff nears; June 30 deadline wall
episodes.summary: The Council of the EU is set to adopt the AI Act Digital Omnibus on June 29, the last step before the deferred high-risk dates are fixed in law. But twin June 30 deadlines (NIS2 first audits, FedRAMP CR26) and a July 1 wall across China, Vietnam, Connecticut and Tennessee leave no breathing room.

episodes.title: Episode 28: July 1 mega-cliff passes; EU AI Act next
episodes.summary: The year's biggest compliance wave hit on July 1, with at least nine regimes taking effect across Connecticut, Utah, Arkansas, Tennessee, Vietnam and China. The calendar barely lets up: UK BNPL and China's anthropomorphic-AI rules land July 15, and the EU AI Act's transparency duties and GPAI enforcement go live August 2.

episodes.title: Episode 29: SCOTUS clears app-store age checks; seven deadlines in three weeks
episodes.summary: The Supreme Court declined to block Texas's app-store age-verification law on 6 July, the first appellate green light for device-level age checks in the US, even as a federal judge enjoined Nebraska's parallel mandate days earlier. China's Order No. 24 imposes mandatory annual data risk assessments from 20 August, and seven hard deadlines land between today and 2 August.

episodes.title: Episode 30: Pentagon suspends CMMC Phase II; regulators start fining
episodes.summary: The Department of War suspended CMMC Phase II on 13 July, cancelling the 10 November C3PAO assessment mandate for 120,000 defence suppliers — but Phase I self-assessments and DFARS 252.204-7012 survive untouched. Meanwhile Ofcom issued its largest age-check fine yet, the UK put AWS, Google, Microsoft and Oracle under financial supervision, and the Commission asked the CJEU to start charging four member states daily penalties over NIS2.

episodes.title: Episode 31: The 2 August Wall: AI Act Article 50
episodes.summary: Ten days from a cluster of hard deadlines: the EU AI Act's Article 50 transparency duties and GPAI fines begin 2 August, California's Delete Act clock starts 1 August, and FedRAMP Ready retires 28 July. Plus France's under-15 social media ban, a $1.07B Medicaid deferral, Korea's PIPC fines, China's IPv6 mandate and the FCC's Covered List order.

episodes.title: Episode 32: The Wall Hits This Weekend
episodes.summary: August's regulatory wall is now three days out and no longer one wall but a cluster across five jurisdictions: EU AI Act Article 50 transparency and GPAI fines start 2 August, California's Delete Act DROP deletion duty binds 1 August, and Germany's BSI NIS2 registration expectation closes 31 July. Plus three new laws — Ireland's AI Act statute, New Jersey's algorithmic-rent ban, and a CISA KEV addition — and the FedRAMP 20x Class A on-ramp opening 3 August.

episodes.title: Episode 33: EU AI Act Enforcement Goes Live
episodes.summary: EU AI Act enforcement went live on 2 August: the AI Office can now supervise and fine general-purpose AI model providers. Plus two deadlines within a fortnight (Netherlands NIS2 on 15 August, China's Order No. 24 on 20 August), the EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting duty from 11 September, and the FTC's health-data case against Hims & Hers.
